newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Internatio-Mueller buys French cargo firms.
newsitem.headline: Internatio-Mueller buys French cargo firms.

text.p: Transport and trading company Internatio-Mueller NV said on Monday it had bought three French cargo firms Watson Brown, AMA and AMC for an undisclosed sum from Cofidec France, owned by SCAC Delmas Vieljeux and Dewulf Cailleret.

The cargo firms have a total of 85 employees and operations in Marseille, Le Havre and Dunkirk with a joint office in Paris, and a turnover of 50 million French francs, Internatio-Mueller said in a statement.
They will continue to trade under their own names.
Internatio-Mueller said this and the recent purchase of a cargo office in St Petersburg would further broaden its European cargo network to 16 cities.
